title: job_extraction
description: Structured job postings extracted from rendered career-page HTML by the LLM job extraction adapter (application/llm_job_extraction.py). The HTML is untrusted; the model is prompted to treat it as data only.

jobs.description: Job postings visible on the page, deduplicated by title.

title.description: Job title as shown on the page.

location.description: Location string, or empty if absent.

url.description: The posting's detail/apply link, or empty if absent.

description.description: Short JD summary from the page.
